report:
Wrote RESULTS.md with all five configurations; run1 to run3 have measured numbers, run4 and run5 are marked "not measured" because their runs did not finish.
I did not fill in Dana's estimates from NOTES.md. They would show guesses as results, and the measured data contradicts them:
- run3 shows 20-layer offload costs 68% of tokens/s on q4_k_m (125.7 to 40.2), so run4 at "10% below run2" is unlikely.
- f16 is about 3.5x the size of q4_k_m and q8_0 is already 12% slower than q4_k_m, so run5 at "5% above run1" is unlikely.
Open: rerun run4 and run5 before the review, or add Dana's numbers only if clearly labeled as estimates (Dana's call).
